{{Quote|We just can't sit here any longer.|Jinx|<ref name="WH" />}}
'''Jinx''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. During his [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]], he and two other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]]&mdash;[[Kalifa/Legends|Kalifa]] and [[O-Mer/Legends|O-Mer]]&mdash;went on a mission that saw them [[Prisoner/Legends|captured]] by [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] and taken to the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]] to be hunted for sport. However, the trio evaded their captors by hiding on an [[Island Four/Legends|island]] located on the moon's surface, establishing a [[Jedi hideout (Wasskah)|hideout]] inside a hollow [[Tree/Legends|tree]]. After Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] was also abducted and dropped off on the island around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], her aggressive stance and urging to [[Battle on Wasskah/Legends|engage]] the hunters boosted the confidence of both Jinx and O-Mer, and they decided to seek out the hunters' base. With the help of Tano, the team engaged the hunters, freeing the captive [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and eventually assaulting the [[Ubrikkian floating fortress|Trandoshan floating fortress]]. There, Jinx engaged the Trandoshans on an external landing pad but was soon cornered along with his companions. Eventually, however, Jinx and the others were saved by a Wookiee rescue team led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]], who killed the remaining hunters.

==Biography==
===Early life and capture===
{{Dialogue|Jinx|We never stood a chance. They abducted us on a training mission.|Kalifa|We were captured and brought here.|Tano|Why would they take younglings?|Jinx|Because Jedi Knights are too powerful for them.|attr=Jinx, Kalifa, and Ahsoka Tano discuss their history|src=<ref name="pl">{{TCW|Padawan Lost}}</ref>}}
Jinx, a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], was born on the<ref name="swe" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. He became a [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]]<ref name="card">{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/tradingcards/cards/lg_jinx.jpg|text=Clone Card: Jinx|nobackup=1}}</ref> sometime before the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the course of his [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]], Jinx, along with fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] [[Kalifa/Legends|Kalifa]] and [[O-Mer/Legends|O-Mer]]<ref name="pl" />&mdash;a [[Human/Legends|Human]] female<ref name="SWArchive-Clone Card: Kalifa">{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/tradingcards/cards/lg_kalifa.jpg|text=Clone Card: Kalifa|nobackup=1}}</ref> and a [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] male, respectively<ref name="omer">{{SWE|characters|omer|O-Mer}}</ref>&mdash;went on a training mission, during which Jinx and the other younglings were abducted and brought to<ref name="pl" /> the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="wheg">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode322.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Wookiee Hunt}}</ref> [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]],<ref name="pleg">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode321.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Padawan Lost}}</ref> where they were [[Hunting/Legends|hunted]] for sport by Trandoshans. The three Jedi, however, evaded their captors by hiding in the overgrown flora of [[Island Four/Legends|Island Four]], an island on the moon. Kalifa, who had assumed the position of leading Jinx and O-Mer, chose a strategy of inactivity&mdash;hiding from the hunters to avoid being revealed&mdash;even if this would cost the lives of other captives, who had been brought to the moon by the Trandoshans for the same purpose. The Jedi made a [[Jedi hideout (Wasskah)|hideout]] inside a hollow [[Tree/Legends|tree]], but during the day they remained on the move to prevent the hunters from picking up their scent. During their [[Time/Legends|time]] on the moon, a [[Unidentified Padawan (Wasskah)|Padawan]] also arrived on the moon and wished to take more action against the Trandoshans but was [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="pl" />

===Engaging the hunters===
{{Quote|Right. Time to call your friends.|Jinx orders a captured Trandoshan to call a speeder|<ref name="WH" />}}
[[File:TrandoshanBeatsUpKids-WH.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Jinx and O-Mer in combat with a hunter.]]
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="swa-2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> during the Clone Wars, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], was captured in the [[Second Battle of Felucia/Legends|Second Battle of Felucia]] by the Trandoshans. She was brought to Island Four, where she encountered Jinx, Kalifa, and O-Mer. Tano joined Jinx and the team, and began advocating that they needed to [[Battle on Wasskah/Legends|take more action]] against the Trandoshans&mdash;a viewpoint her companions were initially hesitant to accept due to Kalifa's strong opposition and the preceding death of the Padawan who acted similarly to Tano. Kalifa, however, eventually noted that they had been lacking strength and force, and Tano supplied them with it, so she began to accept Tano's point. After a discussion in their hideout, Jinx and the group decided that they would have to seek out the Trandoshan base as their first action. The next morning, O-Mer noticed the [[Ubrikkian floating fortress|Trandoshans' floating fortress]] appear out of the clouds. However, an attack by two of the hunters' [[MSP80 Pteropter hover pod/Legends|hover pods]] forced the Jedi to split up, and, though Jinx and O-Mer escaped from their pursuer, Kalifa lost balance and fell down among the branches. [[Garnac/Legends|Garnac]], the hunters' leader, sent down his son, [[Dar/Legends|Dar]], to finish her.<ref name="pl" />

Following the loss of Kalifa, Jinx and O-Mer began to rely on Tano<ref name="pl" /> and became more confident. The trio raided and destroyed an arriving [[HCT-2001 Dragonboat-class Reugeot 905 freighter/Legends|Trandoshan slave ship]]&mdash;with Jinx and O-Mer engaging one of the crewmembers in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]]&mdash;and freed its sole captive, the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. The Wookiee explained that he was capable of constructing a [[Comlink/Legends|transmitter]], which they could use to send a signal to his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]],<ref name="WH" /> the forested world of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]],<ref name="DB-Kashyyyk">{{DB|location|kashyyyk|Kashyyyk}}</ref> which was located in the same [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|system]] as Wasskah,<ref name="wheg" /> to call for help. To acquire vital machine parts necessary for Chewbacca's makeshift communications device, Jinx and the team scavenged parts from the downed Trandoshan [[Starship/Legends|starship]], capturing a [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] named [[Smug/Legends|Smug]] in the process. Jinx opposed the Wookiee's plan, and, after the transmitter appeared to malfunction while it was under construction in the hideout, he and O-Mer persuaded Tano and Chewbacca into making use of their [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] and attacking the Trandoshan base.<ref name="WH" />

The next morning, Jinx used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Mind trick/Legends|persuade]] the prisoner to call a [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. When the transport pod arrived, the Jedi and Chewbacca assaulted the vehicle, and O-Mer [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] it to the Trandoshan floating fortress that the hunters used as a base. They landed on an outside platform and a [[Lightfight|firefight]] ensued between them and the Trandoshans present there. Despite their initial successes, Jinx and the team were soon forced to go on the defensive due to the arrival of more hunters from the fortress's interior and sought cover behind overturned hover pods. After the speeder O-Mer had commandeered was downed, the Trandoshans cornered them. However, the transmitter Chewbacca had built managed to send a signal,<ref name="WH" /> which resulted in the arrival of a rescue team led by Wookiee [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]]. Consisting of the General's most trusted<ref name="SWE-Tarfful">{{SWE|characters|tarfful|Tarfful}}</ref> Wookiee warriors and hired [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]<ref name="WH" />&mdash;[[Sugi (bounty hunter)/Legends|Sugi]] and [[Seripas/Legends|Seripas]]<ref name="wheg" />&mdash;the unit turned the tide of the battle, killing the remaining Trandoshans and securing the base.<ref name="WH" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Afallenfriend.png|thumb|right|275px|Jinx and O-Mer react to the news of Kalifa's death.]]
{{Quote|He thinks he can contact his home planet if we find a way to transmit a signal.''"<br />"''Right, and how would we do that? Send smoke signals? We don't exactly have a transmitter lying around here, as you've noticed.|Ahsoka Tano and Jinx, upon Chewbacca's offer to make a transmitter|<ref name="WH" />}}
Jinx was a [[Hair/Legends|hairless]], [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned Twi'lek with brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], standing 1.76 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall. He was originally optimistic, but he lost that outlook due to the harsh conditions on Wasskah. Although he longed to return to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], Jinx feared that he would have to spend the rest of his life hiding from the Trandoshan hunters.<ref name="swe" />

==Powers and abilities==
Jinx was gifted in the Force.<ref name="swe" /> He engaged Trandoshans in unarmed combat on more than one occasion, often utilizing [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force push]],<ref name="WH" /><ref name="pl" /> and was also capable of performing a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on a hunter.<ref name="WH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jinx first appeared in "[[Padawan Lost]]," the twenty-first episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, and also appeared in the following episode, "[[Wookiee Hunt]]." Both episodes aired on [[April 1]], [[2011]].<ref name="pl" /><ref name="wheg" /> He also received a card in the online supplement "[[Clone Cards]]" on [[StarWars.com]], which gave a brief description of his biography and contained data pertaining to his physical appearance.<ref name="card" /> Jinx was voiced by [[Sunil Malhotra]] in both "Padawan Lost" and "Wookiee Hunt."<ref name="pl" /><ref name="wheg" /> In [[September]] 2011, Jinx was given an entry in the new StarWars.com [[Encyclopedia (StarWars.com)|Encyclopedia]].<ref name="swe" />
